Definition: Verbatim cell from source-layout snapshot, including markers
Parsed printed group mean; no pooled or species-level mean
Printed standard error of the mean, not SD
Area, volume, normalized volume ratio or normalized linear-size ratio; keep separate
Physical units based on caption and footnote; Spinelli CC/CBV are mm2 despite spanning mm3 header
Published statistical significance entries, not recomputed tests
Published percent difference; retain even when inconsistent with means
Printed group n / MRI methods n; effective n of missing scans not reconstructed
Untabulated context and interpretation from paper methods; not pooled data
